# Bundled SYSINFO binary

`SYSINFO.COM` is the standalone SYSINFO 1.0.0-dev7 utility, bundled on the
runtime disk for operator convenience. It is not part of the CP/M compatibility
suite and is not built or archived by this repository.

- Upstream project: sibling repository `../sysinfo`
- SHA-256: `52eb734d511ef82be8e0254c408d9a3d03bd98f905c0c07ed84a034bbacebbf2`

Update this binary and checksum deliberately when adopting a newer upstream
release.
